items.title: OpenAI meets with utility leaders on grid risks from rogue AI - report
items.summary: Investing.com -- OpenAI (NASDAQ:OAI) Chief Executive Sam Altman is pitching the company's cybersecurity capabilities to major U.S. utility executives as the power sector faces growing threats from autonomous cyberattacks, according to a report from POLITICO. items.title: Should You Buy Vistra Stock For Its Shrinking Share Count?
items.summary: Vistra (VST) has fallen about 19% over the past twelve months and trades roughly 30% below its 52-week high, with softer ERCOT power prices and an expected pause in some Texas data-center reviews among the worries. Underneath that tape, the company keeps handing its owners a bigger slice of itself. That is no longer the reason to buy the stock.

items.title: New Study Reveals Strongest State Economies, Only 1 State Was Better Than Texas
